prompt: Write a PowerShell script that scans the Security event log on a Windows host for signs of lateral movement. Look for: Event ID 4624 (Type 3 network logons), Event ID 4688 (process creation), Event ID 4672 (admin logon), and Event ID 10 (WMI activity from Sysmon). Filter for suspicious patterns: logons outside business hours, rundll32/svchost spawning unusual child processes, WMI calls from non-standard users. Output a structured report. Include comments explaining each detection.

result.content:
```powershell
<#
.SYNOPSIS
    Scans Windows Security and Sysmon event logs for signs of lateral movement.
.DESCRIPTION
    This script detects suspicious activities commonly associated with lateral movement:
    - Event ID 4624 (Type 3 network logons) occurring outside business hours.
    - Event ID 4688 (process creation) where rundll32.exe or svchost.exe spawn unusual child processes.
    - Event ID 4672 (special privileges assigned to new logon) indicating admin logons.
    - Event ID 10 (Sysmon ProcessAccess) from WMI-related processes (wmiprvse.exe) accessing sensitive processes.
    Results are output as a structured PowerShell object.
.PARAMETER BusinessHoursStart
    Start of business hours (default 09:00).
.PARAMETER BusinessHoursEnd
    End of business hours (default 17:00).
.PARAMETER BusinessDays
    Days considered business days (default Monday-Friday).
.PARAMETER SuspiciousProcesses
    List of child process names considered suspicious when spawned by rundll32 or svchost.
.PARAMETER OutputPath
    Optional path to export results as CSV.
.EXAMPLE
    .\Invoke-LateralMovementScan.ps1 -OutputPath C:\Reports\lateral.csv
.NOTES
    Author: AI Assistant
    Requires: PowerShell 5.1+, administrative privileges to read Security and Sysmon logs.
#>

[CmdletBinding()]
param(
    [Parameter(Mandatory=$false)]
    [timespan]$BusinessHoursStart = (Get-Date "09:00").TimeOfDay,

    [Parameter(Mandatory=$false)]
    [timespan]$BusinessHoursEnd = (Get-Date "17:00").TimeOfDay,

    [Parameter(Mandatory=$false)]
    [System.DayOfWeek[]]$BusinessDays = @([System.DayOfWeek]::Monday,
                                           [System.DayOfWeek]::Tuesday,
                                           [System.DayOfWeek]::Wednesday,
                                           [System.DayOfWeek]::Thursday,
                                           [System.DayOfWeek]::Friday),

    [Parameter(Mandatory=$false)]
    [string[]]$SuspiciousProcesses = @("cmd.exe", "powershell.exe", "pwsh.exe",
                                       "wscript.exe", "cscript.exe", "reg.exe",
                                       "mshta.exe", "rundll32.exe", "svchost.exe"),

    [Parameter(Mandatory=$false)]
    [string]$OutputPath
)

#region Helper Functions

function Get-EventData {
    <#
    .SYNOPSIS
        Extracts named data from an event's properties.
    .DESCRIPTION
        Uses the event's Properties array to retrieve values by name.
    #>
    param(
        [System.Diagnostics.Eventing.Reader.EventLogRecord]$Event,
        [string]$DataName
    )
    $event.Properties | Where-Object { $_.Value -eq $DataName } | ForEach-Object {
        $index = $event.Properties.IndexOf($_)
        if ($index -ge 0 -and ($index + 1) -lt $event.Properties.Count) {
            $event.Properties[$index + 1].Value
        }
    }
}

function Test-OutsideBusinessHours {
    <#
    .SYNOPSIS
        Checks if a given DateTime falls outside defined business hours/days.
    #>
    param([datetime]$Time)
    $dayOfWeek = $Time.DayOfWeek
    $timeOfDay = $Time.TimeOfDay
    # Outside business days (weekend)
    if ($dayOfWeek -notin $BusinessDays) { return $true }
    # Outside business hours
    if ($timeOfDay -lt $BusinessHoursStart -or $timeOfDay -gt $BusinessHoursEnd) { return $true }
    return $false
}

function New-Detection {
    <#
    .SYNOPSIS
        Creates a custom detection object with common fields.
    #>
    param(
        [datetime]$TimeCreated,
        [int]$EventID,
        [string]$LogName,
        [string]$ComputerName,
        [string]$UserName,
        [string]$DetectionType,
        [string]$Details
    )
    [PSCustomObject]@{
        TimeCreated   = $TimeCreated
        EventID       = $EventID
        LogName       = $LogName
        ComputerName  = $ComputerName
        UserName      = $UserName
        DetectionType = $DetectionType
        Details       = $Details
    }
}

#endregion

#region Main Detection Logic

Write-Verbose "Starting lateral movement scan..."

# Initialize result collection
$results = [System.Collections.Generic.List[PSObject]]::new()

# ------------------------------------------------------------
# 1. Event ID 4624 (Logon) – Type 3 Network Logons outside hours
# ------------------------------------------------------------
Write-Verbose "Querying Security log for Event ID 4624 (Type 3 logons)..."
try {
    $logonEvents = Get-WinEvent -FilterHashtable @{
        LogName   = 'Security'
        ID        = 4624
    } -ErrorAction Stop
} catch {
    Write-Warning "Failed to query Security log for 4624: $_"
    $logonEvents = @()
}

foreach ($event in $logonEvents) {
    # Extract LogonType (property index 8 in 4624)
    $logonType = $event.Properties[8].Value
    if ($logonType -ne 3) { continue }  # Only network logons

    $timeCreated = $event.TimeCreated
    $accountName = $event.Properties[5].Value  # TargetUserName
    $sourceIP    = $event.Properties[18].Value # IpAddress (may be empty)

    # Check if outside business hours
    if (Test-OutsideBusinessHours -Time $timeCreated) {
        $details = "Network logon (Type 3) from IP '$sourceIP' outside business hours."
        $results.Add((New-Detection -TimeCreated $timeCreated -EventID 4624 -LogName 'Security' `
            -ComputerName $event.MachineName -UserName $accountName `
            -DetectionType 'OutsideHoursLogon' -Details $details))
    }
}

# ------------------------------------------------------------
# 2. Event ID 4688 (Process Creation) – Suspicious child processes
# ------------------------------------------------------------
Write-Verbose "Querying Security log for Event ID 4688 (process creation)..."
try {
    $procEvents = Get-WinEvent -FilterHashtable @{
        LogName   = 'Security'
        ID        = 4688
    } -ErrorAction Stop
} catch {
    Write-Warning "Failed to query Security log for 4688: $_"
    $procEvents = @()
}

foreach ($event in $procEvents) {
    # Extract parent process name (property index 17) and new process name (index 5)
    $parentProcess = $event.Properties[17].Value
    $newProcess    = $event.Properties[5].Value
    $accountName   = $event.Properties[1].Value  # SubjectUserName

    # Check if parent is rundll32.exe or svchost.exe (case-insensitive)
    if ($parentProcess -match '\\rundll32\.exe$' -or $parentProcess -match '\\svchost\.exe$') {
        # Check if child process is in suspicious list
        $childName = Split-Path $newProcess -Leaf
        if ($childName -in $SuspiciousProcesses) {
            $details = "Suspicious child process: '$childName' spawned by '$parentProcess'."
            $results.Add((New-Detection -TimeCreated $event.TimeCreated -EventID 4688 -LogName 'Security' `
                -ComputerName $event.MachineName -UserName $accountName `
                -DetectionType 'SuspiciousChildProcess' -Details $details))
        }
    }
}

# ------------------------------------------------------------
# 3. Event ID 4672 (Admin Logon) – Special privileges assigned
# ------------------------------------------------------------
Write-Verbose "Querying Security log for Event ID 4672 (admin logon)..."
try {
    $adminEvents = Get-WinEvent -FilterHashtable @{
        LogName   = 'Security'
        ID        = 4672
    } -ErrorAction Stop
} catch {
    Write-Warning "Failed to query Security log for 4672: $_"
    $adminEvents = @()
}

foreach ($event in $adminEvents) {
    $accountName = $event.Properties[1].Value  # SubjectUserName
    $details = "Admin logon detected (special privileges assigned)."
    $results.Add((New-Detection -TimeCreated $event.TimeCreated -EventID 4672 -LogName 'Security' `
        -ComputerName $event.MachineName -UserName $accountName `
        -DetectionType 'AdminLogon' -Details $details))
}

# ------------------------------------------------------------
# 4. Event ID 10 (Sysmon ProcessAccess) – WMI lateral movement
# ------------------------------------------------------------
Write-Verbose "Querying Sysmon operational log for Event ID 10 (ProcessAccess)..."
try {
    $sysmonEvents = Get-WinEvent -FilterHashtable @{
        LogName   = 'Microsoft-Windows-Sysmon/Operational'
        ID        = 10
    } -ErrorAction Stop
} catch {
    Write-Warning "Failed to query Sysmon log for Event ID 10: $_"
    $sysmonEvents = @()
}

foreach ($event in $sysmonEvents) {
    # Extract SourceProcessName (property index 4) and TargetProcessName (index 6)
    $sourceProcess = $event.Properties[4].Value
    $targetProcess = $event.Properties[6].Value
    $accountName   = $event.Properties[2].Value  # User (domain\user)

    # Check if source is WMI-related (wmiprvse.exe or WmiPrvSE.exe)
    if ($sourceProcess -match '\\wmiprvse\.exe$') {
        # Check if target is a sensitive process (e.g., lsass.exe, svchost.exe, winlogon.exe)
        $targetName = Split-Path $targetProcess -Leaf
        if ($targetName -in @('lsass.exe', 'svchost.exe', 'winlogon.exe', 'services.exe', 'csrss.exe')) {
            # Exclude standard service accounts (SYSTEM, NETWORK SERVICE, LOCAL SERVICE)
            $excludedUsers = @('NT AUTHORITY\SYSTEM', 'NT AUTHORITY\NETWORK SERVICE', 'NT AUTHORITY\LOCAL SERVICE')
            if ($accountName -notin $excludedUsers) {
                $details = "WMI process '$sourceProcess' accessed sensitive process '$targetProcess' from user '$accountName'."
                $results.Add((New-Detection -TimeCreated $event.TimeCreated -EventID 10 -LogName 'Microsoft-Windows-Sysmon/Operational' `
                    -ComputerName $event.MachineName -UserName $accountName `
                    -DetectionType 'WMIProcessAccess' -Details $details))
            }
        }
    }
}

#endregion

# ------------------------------------------------------------
# Output structured report
# ------------------------------------------------------------
if ($results.Count -eq 0) {
    Write-Host "No suspicious lateral movement indicators found." -ForegroundColor Green
} else {
    Write-Host "Found $($results.Count) potential lateral movement indicators:" -ForegroundColor Yellow
    $results | Format-Table -AutoSize -Property TimeCreated, EventID, DetectionType, UserName, Details

    if ($OutputPath) {
        try {
            $results | Export-Csv -Path $OutputPath -NoTypeInformation
            Write-Host "Report exported to: $OutputPath" -ForegroundColor Cyan
        } catch {
            Write-Error "Failed to export CSV: $_"
        }
    }
}

# Optional: return results for further processing
$results
```
